deliverables.verdict: THE APPLIED FIX. First production brief template to exist under new-era/. Every Pass 1 protocol item is a fill-in, greppable field: §0 VOICE_ROUTE + MODEL_SYNTAX + CONTINUITY_OWNER; §1 cast cards (LOOK_PACK slots, CANONICAL_FACE_REF + hash, route-specific VOICE fields, behaviour-shaped PERSONA with NEVER_DOES/NEVER_SAYS, MOTION_SIGNATURE, named WARDROBE_STATES, STATE_OPEN/CLOSE); §2 Pass 3.5 + Pass 4 sign-offs; §3 Sequence Gate + NEW Animatic Gate; §4 per-unit vehicle skeleton with the full spoken-load audit block (tightened F-25 caps, measured_sec, silence budget, implied-rate verdict, span_cost_sec / Container Law), PREV END STATE quote, REFERENCE PRIORITY, STATE_ASSERT, PERSONA_TRANSLATION, OBJECTIVE/OBSTACLE/TACTICS, EYE TASK, four-subfield END STATE, model-syntax speech block, blank-surface TEXT RULE; §5 GATE_LOG sections (four-class drift rows with kill rule, triage-only machine flags, attempt log, three-instrument voice check, per-joint enums, rebuilt master transcription protocol + mechanical diff, ear-test sign-off, NEW Gate (f) Cold Run, calibration ledger); §6 field-presence grep contract; §7 amendment register (15 changes vs Pass 1).
Synthesis: recursive verdict + three angle summaries + what changed in the protocol and why (14 items) + ranked remaining gaps (7) + honest limits.

THE RECURSIVE FINDING: the 2026-11-18 adoption landed in 0 of 10 adopted fields in working artifacts — T=0 (no template field anywhere), V=0 (no production artifact), G-only for all ten; colon-form rule actively contradicted in practice (52x NAME says: quoted in VEHICLES, 32x in SCRIPTs). No standalone production brief template existed anywhere in the repo (8 brief/template files, all MV/research; zero under new-era/). Fairness caveat recorded: V=0 partly timing, T=0 is not.

Cast consistency: field moved to stored, bound assets (Veo 3.1 Ingredients, Kling Elements, LoRA/Soul ID); SOTA between-clip face similarity only ~0.54-0.59 (ConsisID/FCB) so posture is generate-measure-reroll. Voice is the weakest leg: only 3 architectures exist and the Pass 1 spec is a dead letter on the native route -> VOICE_ROUTE declaration adopted. Persona is real but weak (structured > unstructured, drifts in ~8 rounds) -> behaviour+example+negatives shape, per-unit injection + translation. Three legs NOT enough: STATE, PERFORMANCE, MEASUREMENT added.

Speech reliability: F-25 cap too loose by ~40-50% (independent budgets converge 16-20 words/10s one speaker) -> tightened caps adopted, adding a speaker reduces the budget. Speaker ceiling right, default wrong: Camp B (1 speaker/clip) is the field's centre; camps A/B/C/D adopted. Colon/no-quotes supported but model-specific -> MODEL_SYNTAX field. Span law is real but is a CONTAINER LAW (model fills the fixed-duration container, up to inventing words — Kling 4.0 docs). Biggest missing practice: per-line duration budgeting from measured audio (measured_sec + silence budget + implied-rate check adopted).

QC: Sequence Gate strongest but clock-less -> Animatic Gate added. No automated drift score is gate-worthy (ArcFace triage-only, thresholds scatter 0.42-0.88, no stylised-character benchmark; CLIP/DINO consistency preferred a frozen photo 25/25; pHash/vPDQ/SSCD are copy-detection, NOT drift tools). Ear test half-theatre as designed (two Whisper passes = self-agreement; Careless Whisper FAccT 2024) -> VAD + condition_on_previous_text=False + cross-architecture pass 2 + words-in-VAD-silence check. Diarization cannot carry Voice Check (DER 11-47%) -> three-instrument split with honest outcome vocabulary. Highest-value addition: Gate (f) THE COLD RUN, now the final ship blocker.
All online sources from the three angles (100+ URLs) with what each supports, extracted verbatim from the angle files' SOURCES sections; per-claim grades live in the angle files.

headline_verdict: RECURSIVE VERDICT: the Pass 1 fix was itself guide-only — 0/10 adopted fields existed as checkable fields in any working artifact, and no production brief template existed at all. Pass 2 fixed that structurally (template v2 with a grep-contract field-presence checklist) AND corrected the protocol on fresh evidence: F-25 tightened ~40-50%, span law renamed/explained as the Container Law, Camp B default, speech syntax made a model field, VOICE_ROUTE made mandatory, STATE + PERFORMANCE + MEASUREMENT legs added, Animatic Gate added, ear test rebuilt cross-architecture, voice check split into three instruments, Gate (f) Cold Run installed as the final ship blocker. Ranked remaining gaps and honest limits are in REPORT.md §7-§8 (top gap: the template is unproven until the first E3 room runs it with an independent field-presence check).
